questions.stem_md: Radiusi $18$ sm bo'lgan aylana va doira berilgan. Har bir kattalikni uning qiymati bilan moslang (qiymatlar $\pi$ ga ko'paytma ko'rinishida; uzunlik sm da, yuza sm² da).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="242" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="119" y2="39" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 176 110 A 16 16 0 0 0 152 96.1" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="176.5" y="81.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">120°</text><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="151.5" y="118.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="257" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="111.5" y="26" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="209.2" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">18</text></svg>
figure.alt: O markazli aylana, radiusi 18; OA va OB radiuslar orasidagi markaziy burchak 120 gradus.

questions.solution_md:
Aylana uzunligi: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 18=36\pi$.

Doira yuzi: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 18^2=324\pi$.

Sektor yuzi doira yuzining $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ qismi: $\dfrac13\cdot 324\pi=108\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Aylana uzunligini $\pi r$, doira yuzini esa $2\pi r$ deb adashtirish; sektor yuzini butun doira yuzidan kichraytirmasdan yozish.

Площадь круга: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 3^2=9\pi$.

Площадь сектора — $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ площади круга: $\dfrac13\cdot 9\pi=3\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Путают формулы: длина окружности — не $\pi r$, а площадь круга — не $2\pi r$; не берут нужную долю круга для сектора.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="242" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="119" y2="39" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 176 110 A 16 16 0 0 0 152 96.1" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="176.5" y="81.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">120°</text><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="151.5" y="118.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="257" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="111.5" y="26" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="209.2" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Circle with center O and radius 12; the central angle between radii OA and OB is 120 degrees.

en.solution_md:
Circumference: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 12=24\pi$.

Area of the disk: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 12^2=144\pi$.

The sector is $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ of the disk: $\dfrac13\cdot 144\pi=48\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Mixing up the formulas (the circumference is not $\pi r$ and the area is not $2\pi r$), or not taking the right fraction of the disk for the sector.

questions.stem_md: Radiusi $15$ sm bo'lgan aylana va doira berilgan. Har bir kattalikni uning qiymati bilan moslang (qiymatlar $\pi$ ga ko'paytma ko'rinishida; uzunlik sm da, yuza sm² da).

Aylana uzunligi: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 15=30\pi$.

questions.mistake_note_md: Aylana uzunligini $\pi r$, doira yuzini esa $2\pi r$ deb adashtirish; sektor yuzini butun doira yuzidan kichraytirmasdan yozish.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="242" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="119" y2="39" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 176 110 A 16 16 0 0 0 152 96.1" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="176.5" y="81.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">120°</text><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="151.5" y="118.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="257" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="111.5" y="26" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="209.2" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">9</text></svg>
figure.alt: Orayı O, radiusı 9 bolǵan sheńber; OA hám OB radiusları arasındaǵı orayılıq múyesh 120 gradus.

kaa.solution_md:
Sheńber uzınlıǵı: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 9=18\pi$.

Dóńgelek maydanı: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 9^2=81\pi$.

Sektor maydanı dóńgelek maydanınıń $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ bólegi: $\dfrac13\cdot 81\pi=27\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Sheńber uzınlıǵın $\pi r$, dóńgelek maydanın $2\pi r$ dep shatastırıw; sektor maydanın pútkil dóńgelek maydanınan kishirmey jazıw.

en.solution_md:
Circumference: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 9=18\pi$.

Area of the disk: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 9^2=81\pi$.

The sector is $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ of the disk: $\dfrac13\cdot 81\pi=27\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Mixing up the formulas (the circumference is not $\pi r$ and the area is not $2\pi r$), or not taking the right fraction of the disk for the sector.

questions.stem_md: Radiusi $12$ sm bo'lgan aylana va doira berilgan. Har bir kattalikni uning qiymati bilan moslang (qiymatlar $\pi$ ga ko'paytma ko'rinishida; uzunlik sm da, yuza sm² da).

Aylana uzunligi: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 12=24\pi$.

Doira yuzi: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 12^2=144\pi$.

Sektor yuzi doira yuzining $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ qismi: $\dfrac13\cdot 144\pi=48\pi$.

figure.alt: Circle with center O and radius 15; the central angle between radii OA and OB is 120 degrees.

en.solution_md:
Circumference: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 15=30\pi$.

Area of the disk: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 15^2=225\pi$.

The sector is $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ of the disk: $\dfrac13\cdot 225\pi=75\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Mixing up the formulas (the circumference is not $\pi r$ and the area is not $2\pi r$), or not taking the right fraction of the disk for the sector.

questions.stem_md: Radiusi $18$ sm bo'lgan aylana va doira berilgan. Har bir kattalikni uning qiymati bilan moslang (qiymatlar $\pi$ ga ko'paytma ko'rinishida; uzunlik sm da, yuza sm² da).

questions.solution_md:
Aylana uzunligi: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 18=36\pi$.

Doira yuzi: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 18^2=324\pi$.

Sektor yuzi doira yuzining $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ qismi: $\dfrac13\cdot 324\pi=108\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Aylana uzunligini $\pi r$, doira yuzini esa $2\pi r$ deb adashtirish; sektor yuzini butun doira yuzidan kichraytirmasdan yozish.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="242" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="119" y2="39" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 176 110 A 16 16 0 0 0 152 96.1" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="176.5" y="81.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">120°</text><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="151.5" y="118.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="257" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="111.5" y="26" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="209.2" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">12</text></svg>
figure.alt: Orayı O, radiusı 12 bolǵan sheńber; OA hám OB radiusları arasındaǵı orayılıq múyesh 120 gradus.

kaa.solution_md:
Sheńber uzınlıǵı: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 12=24\pi$.

Dóńgelek maydanı: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 12^2=144\pi$.

Sektor maydanı dóńgelek maydanınıń $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ bólegi: $\dfrac13\cdot 144\pi=48\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Sheńber uzınlıǵın $\pi r$, dóńgelek maydanın $2\pi r$ dep shatastırıw; sektor maydanın pútkil dóńgelek maydanınan kishirmey jazıw.

en.solution_md:
Circumference: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 12=24\pi$.

figure.alt: Circle with center O and radius 18; the central angle between radii OA and OB is 120 degrees.

en.solution_md:
Circumference: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 18=36\pi$.

Area of the disk: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 18^2=324\pi$.

The sector is $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ of the disk: $\dfrac13\cdot 324\pi=108\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Mixing up the formulas (the circumference is not $\pi r$ and the area is not $2\pi r$), or not taking the right fraction of the disk for the sector.

questions.stem_md: Radiusi $21$ sm bo'lgan aylana va doira berilgan. Har bir kattalikni uning qiymati bilan moslang (qiymatlar $\pi$ ga ko'paytma ko'rinishida; uzunlik sm da, yuza sm² da).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="242" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="119" y2="39" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 176 110 A 16 16 0 0 0 152 96.1" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="176.5" y="81.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">120°</text><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="151.5" y="118.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="257" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="111.5" y="26" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="209.2" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">21</text></svg>
figure.alt: O markazli aylana, radiusi 21; OA va OB radiuslar orasidagi markaziy burchak 120 gradus.

questions.solution_md:
Aylana uzunligi: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 21=42\pi$.

Doira yuzi: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 21^2=441\pi$.

Sektor yuzi doira yuzining $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ qismi: $\dfrac13\cdot 441\pi=147\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Aylana uzunligini $\pi r$, doira yuzini esa $2\pi r$ deb adashtirish; sektor yuzini butun doira yuzidan kichraytirmasdan yozish.

ru.stem_md: Дана окружность радиуса $21$ см и ограниченный ею круг. Сопоставьте каждую величину с её значением (значения даны как множитель при $\pi$; длина в см, площадь в см²).

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 220" width="320" height="220" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="82" fill="none" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="242" y2="110" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><line x1="160" y1="110" x2="119" y2="39" stroke="#1e1b39" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M 176 110 A 16 16 0 0 0 152 96.1" fill="none" stroke="#6d28d9" stroke-width="1.6"/><text x="176.5" y="81.4" dy="0.35em" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">120°</text><circle cx="160" cy="110" r="2.6" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="151.5" y="118.5" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="257" y="110" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">A</text><text x="111.5" y="26" dy="0.35em" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">B</text><text x="209.2" y="123" dy="0.35em" font-size="14" font-family="sans-serif" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none" text-anchor="middle">21</text></svg>
figure.alt: Окружность с центром O и радиусом 21; центральный угол между радиусами OA и OB равен 120 градусов.

ru.solution_md:
Длина окружности: $C=2\pi r=2\pi\cdot 21=42\pi$.

Площадь круга: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 21^2=441\pi$.

Площадь сектора — $\dfrac{120}{360}=\dfrac13$ площади круга: $\dfrac13\cdot 441\pi=147\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Путают формулы: длина окружности — не $\pi r$, а площадь круга — не $2\pi r$; не берут нужную долю круга для сектора.

Dóńgelek maydanı: $S=\pi r^2=\pi\cdot 21^2=441\pi$.

questions.stem_md: Radiusi $13$ ga teng doiraning markaziy burchagi $180^\circ$ bo'lgan sektorining yuzini toping.

figure.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 200" width="240" height="200"><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="200" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M 90 110 L 170 110 A 80 80 0 0 0 10 110 Z" fill="#c7d2fe" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="90" cy="110" r="2.2" fill="#1e1b39" stroke="none"/><text x="80" y="126.2" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e1b39" font-weight="bold">O</text><text x="130" y="128.2" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#4f46e5" font-weight="bold">13</text><text x="116" y="102.2" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1e1b39" font-weight="bold">180°</text></svg>

questions.solution_md: $S=\frac{\pi r^2\alpha}{360}=\frac{\pi\cdot169\cdot180}{360}=\frac{169}{2}\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Yoy uzunligi $\frac{\pi r\alpha}{180}$, sektor yuzi esa $\frac{\pi r^2\alpha}{360}$: bu ikki formulani va 180/360 ni adashtirish.

questions.stem_md: Markazlari bir xil bo'lgan ikki aylana radiuslari $10$ va $1$ ga teng. Ular orasidagi halqaning yuzini toping.
questions.solution_md: Halqa yuzi katta va kichik doira yuzlarining ayirmasi: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(100-1)=99\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $\pi(R-r)^2$ deb hisoblash: radiuslar ayirmasi emas, yuzlar ayirmasi olinadi.

ru.stem_md: Две концентрические окружности имеют радиусы $10$ и $1$. Найдите площадь кольца между ними.
ru.solution_md: Площадь кольца равна разности площадей кругов: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(100-1)=99\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Считать $\pi(R-r)^2$: вычитают площади кругов, а не радиусы.

kaa.stem_md: Orayları bir bolǵan eki sheńberdiń radiusları $10$ hám $1$ ǵa teń. Olar arasındaǵı saqıyna maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Saqıyna maydanı úlken hám kishi dóńgelek maydanlarınıń ayırması: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(100-1)=99\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $\pi(R-r)^2$ dep esaplaw: radiuslar emes, maydanlar ayırması alınadı.

en.stem_md: Two concentric circles have radii $10$ and $1$. Find the area of the ring between them.
en.solution_md: The ring area is the difference of the disk areas: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(100-1)=99\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Computing $\pi(R-r)^2$: one subtracts the areas, not the radii.

questions.mistake_note_md: $\pi(R-r)^2$ deb hisoblash: radiuslar ayirmasi emas, yuzlar ayirmasi olinadi.

ru.stem_md: Две концентрические окружности имеют радиусы $12$ и $7$. Найдите площадь кольца между ними.
ru.solution_md: Площадь кольца равна разности площадей кругов: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(144-49)=95\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Считать $\pi(R-r)^2$: вычитают площади кругов, а не радиусы.

kaa.stem_md: Orayları bir bolǵan eki sheńberdiń radiusları $12$ hám $7$ ǵa teń. Olar arasındaǵı saqıyna maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Saqıyna maydanı úlken hám kishi dóńgelek maydanlarınıń ayırması: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(144-49)=95\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $\pi(R-r)^2$ dep esaplaw: radiuslar emes, maydanlar ayırması alınadı.

en.stem_md: Two concentric circles have radii $12$ and $7$. Find the area of the ring between them.
en.solution_md: The ring area is the difference of the disk areas: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(144-49)=95\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Computing $\pi(R-r)^2$: one subtracts the areas, not the radii.

ru.stem_md: Две концентрические окружности имеют радиусы $7$ и $1$. Найдите площадь кольца между ними.
ru.solution_md: Площадь кольца равна разности площадей кругов: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(49-1)=48\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Считать $\pi(R-r)^2$: вычитают площади кругов, а не радиусы.

kaa.stem_md: Orayları bir bolǵan eki sheńberdiń radiusları $7$ hám $1$ ǵa teń. Olar arasındaǵı saqıyna maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Saqıyna maydanı úlken hám kishi dóńgelek maydanlarınıń ayırması: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(49-1)=48\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $\pi(R-r)^2$ dep esaplaw: radiuslar emes, maydanlar ayırması alınadı.

en.stem_md: Two concentric circles have radii $7$ and $1$. Find the area of the ring between them.
en.solution_md: The ring area is the difference of the disk areas: $\pi(R^2-r^2)=\pi(49-1)=48\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Computing $\pi(R-r)^2$: one subtracts the areas, not the radii.

questions.stem_md: Markazlari bir xil bo'lgan ikki aylana halqa hosil qiladi. Katta aylananing kichik aylanaga urinuvchi vatari $21$ ga teng. Halqaning yuzini toping.
questions.solution_md: Urinish nuqtasi vatarning o'rtasi: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{21}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=\frac{441}{4}\pi$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Vatarning to'liq uzunligini yarim vatar o'rniga olish ($\pi c^2$): Pifagor teoremasida yarim vatar ishlatiladi.

ru.stem_md: Две концентрические окружности образуют кольцо. Хорда большей окружности, касающаяся меньшей, равна $21$. Найдите площадь кольца.
ru.solution_md: Точка касания — середина хорды: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{21}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=\frac{441}{4}\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Брать всю хорду вместо половины хорды ($\pi c^2$): в теореме Пифагора участвует половина хорды.

kaa.stem_md: Orayları bir bolǵan eki sheńber saqıyna payda etedi. Úlken sheńberdiń kishi sheńberge urınatuǵın xordası $21$ ǵa teń. Saqıyna maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Urınıw noqatı xordanıń ortası: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{21}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=\frac{441}{4}\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Xordanıń tolıq uzınlıǵın yarım xorda ornına alıw ($\pi c^2$): Pifagor teoremasında yarım xorda qollanıladı.

en.stem_md: Two concentric circles form a ring. A chord of the larger circle that touches the smaller one has length $21$. Find the area of the ring.
en.solution_md: The point of tangency is the midpoint of the chord: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{21}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=\frac{441}{4}\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the whole chord instead of half of it ($\pi c^2$): the Pythagorean theorem involves the half-chord.

ru.mistake_note_md: Брать всю хорду вместо половины хорды ($\pi c^2$): в теореме Пифагора участвует половина хорды.

kaa.stem_md: Orayları bir bolǵan eki sheńber saqıyna payda etedi. Úlken sheńberdiń kishi sheńberge urınatuǵın xordası $26$ ǵa teń. Saqıyna maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Urınıw noqatı xordanıń ortası: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{26}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=169\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Xordanıń tolıq uzınlıǵın yarım xorda ornına alıw ($\pi c^2$): Pifagor teoremasında yarım xorda qollanıladı.

en.stem_md: Two concentric circles form a ring. A chord of the larger circle that touches the smaller one has length $26$. Find the area of the ring.
en.solution_md: The point of tangency is the midpoint of the chord: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{26}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=169\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the whole chord instead of half of it ($\pi c^2$): the Pythagorean theorem involves the half-chord.

questions.mistake_note_md: Vatarning to'liq uzunligini yarim vatar o'rniga olish ($\pi c^2$): Pifagor teoremasida yarim vatar ishlatiladi.

ru.stem_md: Две концентрические окружности образуют кольцо. Хорда большей окружности, касающаяся меньшей, равна $8$. Найдите площадь кольца.
ru.solution_md: Точка касания — середина хорды: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{8}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=16\pi$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Брать всю хорду вместо половины хорды ($\pi c^2$): в теореме Пифагора участвует половина хорды.

kaa.stem_md: Orayları bir bolǵan eki sheńber saqıyna payda etedi. Úlken sheńberdiń kishi sheńberge urınatuǵın xordası $8$ ǵa teń. Saqıyna maydanın tabıń.
kaa.solution_md: Urınıw noqatı xordanıń ortası: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{8}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=16\pi$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Xordanıń tolıq uzınlıǵın yarım xorda ornına alıw ($\pi c^2$): Pifagor teoremasında yarım xorda qollanıladı.

en.stem_md: Two concentric circles form a ring. A chord of the larger circle that touches the smaller one has length $8$. Find the area of the ring.
en.solution_md: The point of tangency is the midpoint of the chord: $R^2-r^2=\left(\frac{8}{2}\right)^2$. $S=\pi(R^2-r^2)=16\pi$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the whole chord instead of half of it ($\pi c^2$): the Pythagorean theorem involves the half-chord.

en.mistake_note_md: Using the whole chord instead of half of it ($\pi c^2$): the Pythagorean theorem involves the half-chord.

questions.stem_md: Doiraviy sektor yoyining uzunligi $10\pi$ ga, sektor yuzi esa $100\pi$ ga teng.

a.hint: Javobni butun son yoki oddiy kasr (masalan 7/3) ko'rinishida yozing.

b.prompt_md: b) Sektorning markaziy burchagini (gradusda) toping.
b.hint: Javobni butun son yoki oddiy kasr (masalan 7/3) ko'rinishida yozing.

questions.solution_md:
a) $S=\frac12 lr$ dan $r=\frac{2S}{l}=\frac{2\cdot100\pi}{10\pi}=20$.

b) $l=\frac{\pi r\alpha}{180}$ dan $\alpha=\frac{180\cdot10\pi}{\pi\cdot20}=90$.
questions.mistake_note_md: $S=\frac12 lr$ formulasidagi $\frac12$ ni tushirib qoldirish (radius ikki marta katta chiqadi); burchakni radianda topib, gradusga o'tkazmaslik.

ru.stem_md: Длина дуги кругового сектора равна $10\pi$, а площадь сектора равна $100\pi$.

a.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом или обыкновенной дробью (например 7/3).

b.prompt_md: б) Найдите центральный угол сектора (в градусах).
b.hint: Запишите ответ целым числом или обыкновенной дробью (например 7/3).

ru.solution_md:
а) $S=\frac12 lr$, откуда $r=\frac{2S}{l}=\frac{2\cdot100\pi}{10\pi}=20$.

б) Из $l=\frac{\pi r\alpha}{180}$: $\alpha=\frac{180\cdot10\pi}{\pi\cdot20}=90$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Пропустить множитель $\frac12$ в $S=\frac12 lr$ (радиус получается вдвое больше); найти угол в радианах и не перевести в градусы.

a.hint: Juwaptı pútin san yamasa ápiwayı bólshek (mısalı 7/3) kórinisinde jazıń.

kaa.solution_md:
a) $S=\frac12 lr$ nan $r=\frac{2S}{l}=\frac{2\cdot100\pi}{10\pi}=20$.

b) $l=\frac{\pi r\alpha}{180}$ nan $\alpha=\frac{180\cdot10\pi}{\pi\cdot20}=90$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: $S=\frac12 lr$ formulasındaǵı $\frac12$ di umıtıw (radius eki ese úlken shıǵadı); múyeshti radianda tawıp, gradusqa ótkermew.

en.stem_md: The arc of a circular sector has length $10\pi$ and the sector has area $100\pi$.

a.prompt_md: a) Find the radius of the sector.
a.hint: Write the answer as an integer or a common fraction (for example 7/3).

b.prompt_md: b) Find the central angle of the sector (in degrees).
b.hint: Write the answer as an integer or a common fraction (for example 7/3).

en.solution_md:
a) From $S=\frac12 lr$: $r=\frac{2S}{l}=\frac{2\cdot100\pi}{10\pi}=20$.

b) From $l=\frac{\pi r\alpha}{180}$: $\alpha=\frac{180\cdot10\pi}{\pi\cdot20}=90$.
en.mistake_note_md: Dropping the $\frac12$ in $S=\frac12 lr$ (the radius comes out twice too big); finding the angle in radians and not converting to degrees.

a.prompt_md: a) Find the radius of the sector.
a.hint: Write the answer as an integer or a common fraction (for example 7/3).

b.prompt_md: b) Find the central angle of the sector (in degrees).
b.hint: Write the answer as an integer or a common fraction (for example 7/3).

en.solution_md:
a) From $S=\frac12 lr$: $r=\frac{2S}{l}=\frac{2\cdot1\pi}{1\pi}=2$.

b) From $l=\frac{\pi r\alpha}{180}$: $\alpha=\frac{180\cdot1\pi}{\pi\cdot2}=90$.
en.mistake_note_md: Dropping the $\frac12$ in $S=\frac12 lr$ (the radius comes out twice too big); finding the angle in radians and not converting to degrees.
